output.answer: Adobe employed 31,360 people as of November 28, 2025 (the end of its fiscal 2025), according to its FY2025 Form 10-K filed with the SEC in January 2026 — 50% in the United States and 50% at international locations. That is up about 2% from 30,709 employees reported a year earlier in the FY2024 10-K. Headcount trackers based on LinkedIn profiles currently show a higher figure (about 43,500), but the 10-K figure is the authoritative official count.
caveats: The 31,360 figure is as of November 28, 2025 (fiscal year-end); Adobe's actual headcount today may differ slightly, and the company does not report headcount more frequently than annually.

LinkedIn-based trackers such as AltIndex show ~43,517 people listing Adobe as their current employer, which counts profiles rather than official payroll and runs higher than filed figures; the 10-K number is the authoritative one.
Adobe's fiscal 2026 year ends in late November/early December 2026, so the next official annual headcount will not be available until the FY2026 10-K is filed (expected January 2027).

passages.quote: Adobe for All is our belief in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. Our founding principle is that great ideas come from anywhere and when people are respected and included, they are more creative, innovative and successful. The wealth of unique perspectives and experiences that our employees bring is vital to our business growth, fueling the product innovation and value that we deliver to billions of people around the world. We are continually investing in our global workforce to provide fair and market-competitive pay and benefits to support our employees’ wellbeing and foster their growth and development. As of November 28, 2025, we employed 31,360 people, of which 50% were in the United States and 50% were in our international locations. During fiscal 2025, our total attrition rate was 9.9%. We have not experienced work stoppages and believe our employee relations are good. Understanding employee sentiment and listening to employee feedback is important to Adobe. We utilize a variety of feedback mechanisms throughout an employee lifecycle to gather insights that help inform our decision-making regarding employee programs, talent risks, management opportunities, employee networks and more. In fiscal 2025, 78% of our employees participated in our most recent engagement survey.
